title: Settings › feedback (reserved content preview)
expect: The two-action system menu opens automatically from the full-width feedback row with its colored icon tile and primary title; iPhone shows a chevron and the Mac list row has no trailing glyph.
Email exports an immutable diagnostics file; the preview and composer never send automatically.
iPhone uses the system mail composer when configured, otherwise mailto plus the system file share sheet.
Mac uses NSSharingService composeEmail with the diagnostics attachment.
The reserved Rate BackupDuck row appears with arrow.up.right on both hosts and forms its review URL from a placeholder App Store app ID.
The email recipient is feedback@example.invalid; this is design-only placeholder content.

actions.result: Join the User Feedback Group and Email Us (Attach Diagnostics) appear in a system menu.

actions.action: Choose Email, inspect the diagnostics attachment, then cancel the composer
actions.result: No email is sent; the exported file remains available for another attempt.
